project.name: LearningQuest
project.summary: Mobile-first LearningQuest static learning platform foundation with PWA shell, content-pack registry, browser-local progress, validation, mobile smoke tests, and deployment notes.
goals: Provide a reusable, mobile-native learning practice product foundation with curriculum packs and browser-local learner progress.
Keep static app runtime, content-pack registry, starter packs, PWA shell, validation, mobile smoke tests, and deployment docs coherent.
Continue generalizing from family prototype toward public commercial-grade learning product behavior without hardcoded private learner assumptions.
nonGoals: Own a company-wide education platform, every future curriculum, school admissions policy, or private learner identity source of truth.
Hide one family's private data, school-specific policy, or learner-specific behavior in reusable product defaults.
Publish enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, org rulesets, rollout issue reconciliation, or shared CI policy.

owns.name: learningquest-static-app
owns.description: The static app shell, Node server, PWA assets, browser-local learner progress model, export/import behavior, and product UI.

owns.name: learningquest-content-packs
owns.description: The content-pack registry, starter curriculum packs, question bank, schemas, and runtime loading behavior.

owns.name: learningquest-validation
owns.description: Static validation script, Playwright mobile smoke test, Dockerfile, deployment notes, and CI workflow evidence.

doesNotOwn: Company-wide education platform ownership, all future curriculum, school admissions policy, or private learner identity source of truth.
Private family data, one learner's personalized policy, school-specific admissions guarantees, or external content-provider behavior.
Enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, rollout issue reconciliation, org rulesets, or shared workflow implementation.

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema, standards, and rollout audit
documented Playwright browser smoke testing behavior

forbiddenCouplings: Do not hardcode private learner names, school-specific promises, or family-only behavior as reusable product defaults.
Do not make curriculum packs depend on undocumented app internals instead of the content-pack registry contract.
Do not make other education products import this repository's internal question bank, progress model, or static app implementation without a documented public surface.
Do not publish enterprise process policy from this repository instead of SylphxAI/doctrine or SylphxAI/.github.

delivery.deployPath: Pull requests and merge groups run .github/workflows/ci.yml for validation, build, and Playwright mobile smoke; deployment uses the normal Sylphx product path for project tart-duo-uvt9.
delivery.productionProof: Production changes require CI plus deployed app readback for affected routes, content packs, PWA assets, and browser-local progress export/import behavior.

gaps.description: Upgrade from legacy CI to ADR-29 admission contexts when the app is ready for full central policy enforcement.
Document the boundary between family prototype data, public product foundation, and reusable curriculum-pack contract.
Document the hosting URL, product-path readback, PWA smoke, and content-pack smoke required after production changes.
